This course teaches African women to produce a complete range of candles - from basic pillar and container candles to decorative and scented gift candles - using locally available wax, wicks, fragrance oils, and colourants. Candle making is one of the most accessible craft businesses: the equipment cost is minimal, the production space requirement is small, and the finished product has broad appeal across household, gift, event, and institutional markets. This course covers safety, materials, production techniques, troubleshooting, packaging, and business development.

This course teaches African women to produce a complete range of household and institutional cleaning products - including liquid detergent, dishwashing liquid, toilet bowl cleaner, floor cleaner, glass cleaner, and multi-surface spray - from locally available raw materials. Each product is taught with full formulas, step-by-step production processes, quality testing, packaging strategies, and pricing guidance. No chemistry background is required. Every concept is explained in plain, practical language.

This course builds directly on Basic Tailoring & Garment Repair and takes women into the world of fashion understanding, style principles, and clothing alterations. You will learn how fashion works - silhouettes, style lines, colour coordination, and dressing for body types - then apply this knowledge to practical alterations: reshaping garments, changing necklines, adjusting sleeves, adding style details, and transforming old clothing into fashionable new pieces. This course bridges the gap between repair skills and fashion entrepreneurship.

This course teaches African women to extend the shelf life of food through proven preservation and storage methods - including drying, fermenting, pickling, smoking, canning, and freezing. Learners will understand why food spoils, how each preservation method works scientifically, and how to apply these skills both at home and as a food business. Reducing food waste, extending the value of harvests and surplus produce, and creating value-added preserved food products for sale are the core outcomes of this course.
Why Food Spoils & How to Stop It

This course equips African women with practical hair care and simple styling skills for personal use and income generation. Covering hair anatomy, scalp health, washing and conditioning techniques, natural hair care, simple braiding, threading, and basic protective styles, this course prepares learners to confidently care for their own and their family's hair - and to offer basic hair services within their community. No prior experience is required.
DIY Hair Products, Hygiene & Building a Home

This course takes you beyond everyday cakes and bread into the world of professional baking and pastry. You will master the science behind baking - why cakes rise, why bread has texture, what makes pastry flaky or crisp - so you can fix problems and create consistently excellent products. You will also learn to produce high-value items: layered cakes, laminated pastry, artisan bread, choux pastry, and custom celebration cakes that command premium prices in the Nigerian and African market.

Jewellery is one of the most profitable handmade businesses in Africa. This course takes you beyond basic stringing and simple beadwork into professional jewellery design and construction. You will master wire wrapping, metal work basics, resin jewellery, advanced beading techniques including peyote and brick stitch, African bead traditions, and the business skills to sell your pieces at boutique prices. A single well-crafted piece can sell for ₦5,000-₦80,000+ depending on materials and design skill.

This course takes your cooking beyond daily household meals into the realm of professional food production, catering, and nutrition science. You will learn advanced cooking techniques used in professional kitchens, understand how to plan nutritionally balanced meals for families and institutions, run a home catering business, and produce packaged food products for sale. Whether you want to cater events, run a food business from home, or simply feed your family better - this course gives you the knowledge and skills to do it.
African Cuisine at a Professional Level

This course elevates your knitting and crochet skills from basic stitches to professional garment construction and product design. You will master complex stitch patterns, read and adapt patterns from any source, make garments sized for the human body, and create a product line of handmade items priced and packaged for the Nigerian and African market. Whether your goal is personal creative expression, a craft business, or supplying boutiques and gift shops - this course gives you the skills and business knowledge to succeed.

This intermediate course takes your tailoring skills to the next level. You will move beyond basic repairs and simple sewing to create original garments from scratch, draft your own patterns, understand body measurements professionally, and produce market-quality clothes that command higher prices. Whether you want to open a home tailoring business, supply boutiques, or create your own fashion label, this course gives you the technical foundation to do it.

The difference between a garment that looks homemade and one that looks store-bought is almost always in the finishing. This course teaches you every technique that separates amateur sewing from professional fashion work - clean hems, perfectly set collars and cuffs, invisible zips, professional linings, decorative details, and a rigorous quality control process. By the end, every garment you produce will meet boutique standards.

You already know how to make laundry and bath soap. This course takes you into the higher-value liquid products that dominate households, salons, hospitals, and offices across Africa - liquid hand soap, dish wash, shampoo, hair conditioner, fabric softener, and hospital-grade disinfectants. These products sell faster, cost less to ship, and command better margins than bar soap. By the end of this course, you will have a full liquid hygiene product range ready for market.

This course teaches African women to produce high-quality laundry soap and bath soap from scratch using locally available ingredients. Starting from understanding the science of saponification, through raw material sourcing, safety handling, and the complete production process, this course gives learners the knowledge and practical skills to produce soap for home use and for profitable sale. No chemistry background is needed - every concept is explained clearly and practically.
